key.name: focus-duration
key.description: The duration of the focus period in minutes.

key.name: short-break-duration
key.description: The duration of the short break in minutes.

key.name: long-break-duration
key.description: The duration of the long break in minutes.

key.name: long-break-interval
key.description: The number of focus sessions before a long break.

key.name: preset
key.description: classic, deep-work, sprint, or custom.

key.name: daily-goal
key.description: Target number of focus sessions per day.

key.name: sound-choice
key.description: none, bundled, freedesktop:NAME, or custom:/absolute/path.

key.name: show-countdown
key.description: Whether the panel button shows the remaining time.

key.name: auto-open-on-completion
key.summary: Auto-open popup when a session ends
key.description: Open the extension popup when a focus session completes.

key.name: sound-enabled
key.description: Whether to play a sound when a focus or break session finishes.

key.name: sound-file
key.description: Absolute path to a custom sound file, or empty for the bundled default.

key.name: autostart-next-session
key.description: When enabled, the next session starts automatically after the current one finishes.

key.name: single-progress-bar
key.summary: Show a combined cycle progress bar
key.description: When enabled, the ring shows the combined focus+break cycle.

key.name: last-active-date
key.description: The last calendar date (local time) the extension was active, YYYY-MM-DD.

key.name: today-stats
key.description: Cache derived from history-json for the current local calendar day.

key.name: history-json
key.description: Authoritative JSON array of completed focus/break sessions.

key.name: tasks-json
key.description: JSON array of tasks with title, estimate, completed, done, createdAt.

key.name: notes
key.description: Autosaved scratchpad text.

key.name: timer-state
key.description: Persisted timer phase, remaining milliseconds, and cycle count.

key.name: current-cycle-index
key.description: Number of focus sessions completed for the current day.

key.name: current-session-type
key.description: Current session type (0=focus, 1=short break, 2=long break).
